facts.fact: The National Bank of Rwanda says it is working with financial institutions on delayed and failed eKash transfers on the national digital payment system, with rejection below 2% by September 2026.
Governor Hakuziyaremye says Rwanda's consumer-protection framework requires failed transfers to be refunded in a timely manner.
BNR says users with unresolved payment problems can contact it through social media or the Intumwa chatbot so it can establish what happened and whether to refund.

facts.fact: BNR's October 2026 financial sector report puts eKash active accounts at 10.3 million and monthly transactions at 28.9 million in September 2026.
eKash transfers pass between the originating and receiving financial institutions, and the National Instant Payment System is meant to improve interoperability between payment providers.
